summary.zh: 所有茶（绿、红、乌龙、普洱）都来自这一种植物。
summary.en: All true teas — green, black, oolong, pu-erh — come from this one species.

field_marks.zh: 常绿灌木，叶革质、边缘有细齿；秋季开白色小花，花黄蕊多。
field_marks.en: Evergreen shrub, leathery serrate leaves; small white autumn flowers with many yellow stamens.

story.zh: 基因组研究显示茶与咖啡各自独立演化出咖啡因合成能力，这是趋同演化的有力例子。
story.en: Genome work shows tea and coffee evolved caffeine biosynthesis independently — a clear case of convergent evolution.

notes.zh: 春茶采摘约 3–5 月；10–12 月为花期。茶园内请沿步道行走，勿采摘。
notes.en: Spring harvest runs March–May; flowers appear October–December. Stay on paths in plantations and do not pick leaves.
